notes.title: Release of Demo 2.0!
notes.notes:
This demo is single player and will introduce the main concepts of combat in Guardians of Gaia.

 [olist]
 Poise system: Create an opening by breaking down the opponents guard.
 Positioning: Use both high and low attacks to find an opening.
 Combat Arts: Use advanced techniques, unique to each Guardian.
 Special Moves: Parry, guard and attack to charge the EX-meter and unleash devastating attacks.
 Weapons: Experiment with a wide array of weapons,
 Elemental system: Expose your opponents elemental weaknesses.
 Stealth: Use long foliage and aerial advantage to conceal your position.
[/olist]

8 Guardians are featured in the demo across 8 rounds.
Feel up to the challenge?
